description.en: The outdoor (source side) reversible coil of heat pump equipment, which exchanges heat with the ambient outdoor airstream. It acts as a condenser when the equipment is cooling and as an evaporator when the equipment is heating. Used in place of an air cooled condenser for reversible (heat pump) equipment; a non-reversible, cooling-only outdoor heat exchanger should be modeled as an AirCooledCondenser.
